task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket window title or file menu shows 'janus_29mm.ork' is loaded.

task_completion.visual_evidence: Component configuration dialogs for the Nose Cone, Body Tubes, and Fins showing the material density set to 0.65 g/cm³ or 650 kg/m³.

task_completion.description: Adjust the design (e.g., adding ballast) to reach a stability margin of at least 1.50 calibers.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket main interface or simulation summary showing a stability value ≥ 1.50 cal.

task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog or the application title bar reflecting the new filename 'janus_lw_pla.ork'.

task_completion.description: Export a text report documenting density, ballast mass, and final stability margin to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command showing the content of /home/ga/Documents/exports/lw_pla_report.txt containing the required metrics.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI to modify the rocket design rather than just editing files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the cursor interacting with OpenRocket component menus and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The stability margin is derived from the software's calculation, not manually typed into a fake report.
integrity.visual_evidence: The stability margin in the final report matches the stability margin displayed in the OpenRocket status bar/side panel.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create the report file without performing the design changes in the software.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the density values being changed in the component property windows.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target density is 0.65 g/cm³ (equivalent to 650 kg/m³). The required stability margin is ≥ 1.50 calibers. The source file is janus_29mm.ork and the output must be janus_lw_pla.ork. The report must be at /home/ga/Documents/exports/lw_pla_report.txt and must contain the density (0.65), the ballast mass added (likely > 0.01kg to reach stability), and the final stability margin.
